d: You might have noticed something stuck to the temples of Indian cricket team captain Shubman Gill and Indian badminton star PV Sindhu. If you haven’t, take a look during the ongoing ODI series. This device, attached to their temples, is a product from 'Temple'—a company founded by Zomato’s Deepinder Goyal—and it is also called 'Temple'. It is priced at 85,000 rupees. Although this device which adheres to the forehead has not yet hit the market, it has sparked a flurry of questions on social media. For instance, what exactly is this "Temple" device? Is it a fitness tracker, a wellness tool,…
